app.tagline: Host a Minecraft server for your friends, no command line needed.

quit.title: Quit MineHost?
quit.body_one: {{count}} server is running. Stop it safely and quit?
quit.body_other: {{count}} servers are running. Stop them all safely and quit?
quit.done: MineHost has shut down. You can close this tab; start MineHost again when you need it.

system.heading: Your computer
system.description: The computer running MineHost and where data is stored.

servers.heading: Your servers
servers.emptyDescription: Set up a Paper server in a few minutes. MineHost downloads Java and everything else for you.
servers.name: Name

wizard.title: Create server
wizard.kindStandardDescription: Play vanilla or add lightweight plugins.
wizard.kindModdedDescription: Pick individual mods with Fabric, NeoForge, Forge or Quilt.
wizard.kindModpackDescription: Install a ready-made modpack from Modrinth or CurseForge.
wizard.vanillaDescription: The original server from Mojang, no plugins.
wizard.fabricDescription: Lightweight, updates quickly, with a large library of modern mods.
wizard.neoforgeDescription: Modern fork of Forge for recent Minecraft versions, used by many large mods.
wizard.forgeDescription: Long-standing loader required by classic mods and older Minecraft versions.
wizard.quiltDescription: Forked from Fabric and compatible with most Fabric mods.
wizard.loaderVersionHint: Defaults to the recommended stable version for the selected Minecraft version.
wizard.versionHint: Your friends need this exact version to join.
wizard.noVersions: Paper has no stable version yet. Please try again later.
wizard.name: Server name
wizard.nameHint: Friends also see this name in Minecraft's server list.
wizard.nameInvalid: The name must be 1 to 64 characters long.
wizard.memoryHint: More players or plugins need more RAM.
wizard.memoryWarning: Only {{free}} of RAM is free. The server will run, but your computer may slow down.
wizard.portHint: Leave empty and MineHost picks a free port, starting at 25565.
wizard.portInvalid: The port must be a number from 1024 to 65535.
wizard.creatingDescription: The first time can take a few minutes because MineHost needs to download Java.
wizard.purpurDescription: Based on Paper: supports plugins and adds many gameplay options.
wizard.importDescription: Already have a Paper, Purpur or Vanilla server on this computer: MineHost copies it in and manages it.
wizard.importPathHint: Full path on this computer, for example C:\Users\you\Desktop\server or /home/you/server. The original folder is left as is.
wizard.importNoJar: No .jar file found in this folder.
wizard.importIgnoredJvmArgs: This folder contains user_jvm_args.txt. MineHost ignores that file to manage memory safely.
wizard.importNote: MineHost copies the folder into its own data folder; the original stays as is. You will be asked to accept the EULA before the first start.

server.killBody: The server stops immediately without saving. Players may lose what they did in the last few minutes.
server.restartPending: The server will start again in a few seconds.
server.slowStart: The server has been starting for over 5 minutes. Check the console to see what it is doing.

broken.title: This server cannot be read
broken.missing_instance: The server folder has no instance.toml file.
broken.newer_schema: This server was created by a newer MineHost. Please update MineHost.
broken.id_mismatch: The ID in instance.toml ({{found}}) does not match the folder name. The folder may have been copied by hand.

crashHints.NOT_ENOUGH_MEMORY: The server ran out of RAM. Give it more RAM on the Server settings page.
crashHints.WRONG_JAVA: The server needs a different Java version. This is a MineHost bug, please report it.
crashHints.PORT_IN_USE: Another program is using the server's port. Change the port on the Server settings page.
crashHints.EULA_NOT_ACCEPTED: Accept the Minecraft EULA, then start the server again.
crashHints.GAME_ERROR: The game or a plugin failed. Check the console for details, then try restarting.
crashHints.MEMORY_LIMIT: MineHost stopped the server because it went over its RAM limit. A mod or plugin may be leaking memory; check the console, or give the server more RAM in Server settings.
crashHints.unknown: The cause is unknown. Check the console for details.

eula.title: Minecraft End User License Agreement
eula.body: Minecraft requires you to accept Mojang's End User License Agreement (EULA) before running a server.

console.label: Server log
console.placeholder: Type a command and press Enter, e.g. say hello
console.offline: Start the server to send commands

game.advancedHint: Every key in server.properties. Change the port on the Server settings page.
game.empty: server.properties has no keys yet. Start the server once so Minecraft fills it in.
game.restartNote: Takes effect after the server restarts.

fields.pvp: Allow players to fight each other (PvP)

hints.motd: Shown under the server name in Minecraft's server list.
hints.white-list: Add players with the command whitelist add <name> in the console.
hints.online-mode: When off, anyone can join with any name, including someone else's.

settings.title: Server settings
settings.autostartHint: The server runs every time MineHost starts.
settings.restartOnCrashHint: Tries up to 3 times within 10 minutes.
settings.restartAtHint: In the clock of the computer running MineHost, up to 4 times. Players are warned 5 minutes, 1 minute and 10 seconds before. Skipped while the server is stopped.
settings.restartAtInvalid: Pick both hour and minute for every time.
settings.ignoredJvmArgs: This server folder contains user_jvm_args.txt, which MineHost ignores in favor of the memory setting below.

delete.title: Delete server
delete.description: The server folder moves to MineHost's trash and can be restored by hand.
delete.stopFirst: Stop the server before deleting it.
delete.confirmBody: The server disappears from MineHost. The world and files stay in MineHost's trash/ folder.
delete.done: The server was moved to the trash

ui.copyFailed: Couldn't copy. Select the text and copy it manually.

errors.INTERNAL: Something went wrong. See the MineHost log file for details.
errors.NETWORK: Cannot reach MineHost. Check that MineHost is still running.
errors.PLAYER_NOT_FOUND: No Minecraft account has this name.
errors.PATH_OUTSIDE_ROOT: The path is outside the allowed folder.
errors.PORT_IN_USE: Port {{port}} is used by another program.
errors.SERVER_BUSY: The server is busy and cannot do this right now.
errors.EULA_NOT_ACCEPTED: You need to accept the Minecraft EULA before starting the server.
errors.VERSION_NOT_FOUND: This Minecraft version was not found.
errors.NETWORK_UNAVAILABLE: Cannot reach the Internet. Check your connection and try again.
errors.DOWNLOAD_FAILED: The download failed partway. Please try again.
errors.CHECKSUM_MISMATCH: The downloaded file is damaged. Please try again.
errors.JAVA_INSTALL_FAILED: Could not install Java. Please try again.
errors.NOT_ENOUGH_DISK: Less than 1 GB of disk space is free. Free up some space and try again.
errors.FORBIDDEN: The request was refused because it did not come from the MineHost page on this computer.
errors.UNSUPPORTED_BY_VERSION: This Minecraft version does not support this action.
errors.AUTH_RATE_LIMITED: Too many wrong passwords. Try again in {{retry_after_s}} seconds.
errors.PASSWORD_TOO_SHORT: Password must be at least 8 characters.
errors.LAN_NEEDS_PASSWORD: Set a password before turning on LAN access.
errors.BACKUP_CORRUPT: The backup is damaged or its checksum does not match.
errors.FILE_TOO_LARGE: The file is larger than allowed.
errors.FILE_NOT_TEXT: This file is not valid UTF-8 text.
errors.FILE_CHANGED: The file changed since it was opened. Reload the latest version.
errors.FILE_EXISTS: A file or folder with that name already exists.
errors.BACKUP_PROTECTED: This backup is protected. Remove the protection before deleting it.
errors.MODS_NOT_SUPPORTED: This server has mods (a mods folder). Mods are not supported yet; they come in a later version.
errors.SERVER_NOT_RUNNING: The server is not running. Start it and try again.
errors.LOADER_INSTALL_FAILED: Could not install the mod loader. See the job log for details.
errors.CONTENT_INCOMPATIBLE: This mod or plugin has no version for this server type and Minecraft version.
errors.CONTENT_NOT_FOUND: This mod, plugin or modpack was not found. It may have been removed from its source.
errors.DEPENDENCY_MISSING: Required mods are missing. Install them, then start the server again.
errors.CURSEFORGE_UNAVAILABLE: CurseForge is unavailable: there is no API key or the key was rejected. See CurseForge in Settings.
errors.CURSEFORGE_FILES_PENDING: Some CurseForge files must be downloaded by hand. Open the Mods page to download and drop them in.
errors.UPLOAD_HASH_MISMATCH: The uploaded file does not match the expected file. Download the exact version from the mod page.
errors.MODPACK_INVALID: The modpack file is invalid or damaged.
errors.DOWNLOAD_HOST_NOT_ALLOWED: A file points to a site that is not allowed, so MineHost did not download it.
errors.UPSTREAM_RATE_LIMITED: The source site is rate limiting requests. Try again in {{retry_after_s}} seconds.

jobsPage.description: What MineHost is doing or just finished, such as creating a server or making a backup.
jobsPage.emptyHint: Tasks show up here when you create a server or make a backup.

overview.offline: The server is stopped. Start it to see CPU and RAM.

home.summaryNone: No server is running. Start one so your friends can join.

files.name: Name
files.deleteBody: It is moved to MineHost's trash, so you can get it back later.
files.uploadHint: or drop files here, up to 512 MiB each
files.changedBody: Someone (or the server) edited this file after you opened it. Reloading discards your changes; copy them first if you need them.

auth.title: Sign in
auth.description: An admin password is set for MineHost on this computer.
auth.locked: Too many wrong attempts. Try again in {{seconds}} seconds.
auth.forgot: Forgot the password? On the computer running MineHost, run minehost reset-password, or right-click the MineHost tray icon → Reset password (Windows).

appSettings.securityOff: No password set: anyone who can open a browser on this computer can use MineHost.
appSettings.securityOn: A password is set. Opening MineHost, even on this computer, requires signing in.
appSettings.newHint: At least 8 characters. After setting or changing it you will need to sign in again.
appSettings.lanSwitch: Let other computers on the LAN open MineHost
appSettings.lanHint: Other computers on the same Wi-Fi or home network can open this interface after signing in.
appSettings.lanNeedsPassword: Set a password under Security before turning this on.
appSettings.lanWarning: The LAN interface uses HTTP without encryption: people on the same network could read your password when you sign in. Only turn this on at home on a network you trust, never on public Wi-Fi.
appSettings.lanNoAddress: No LAN address could be opened yet. The computer may not be on a LAN, or another program is using the port.
appSettings.lanDescription: Let phones and other computers at home open MineHost over the LAN.
appSettings.description: Password, access from other devices at home, and details of the computer running MineHost.

backups.nowHint: Saves the current world and settings. A running server can be backed up; players stay connected.
backups.noteHint: Optional, up to 200 characters. For example: Before changing version.
backups.protectHint: A protected backup is never removed automatically and cannot be deleted until unprotected.
backups.autoHint: Manual and protected backups are never removed automatically. Skipped if the server has not run since the last backup.
backups.timeHint: In the clock of the computer running MineHost.
backups.emptyHint: Press Back up above, or turn on the automatic schedule.
backups.restoreBody: The current world and settings will be replaced by the backup from {{time}}. MineHost backs up the current state first.
backups.restoreStops: The running server will be stopped before restoring and will not start again by itself.
backups.deleteBody: Permanently delete the backup from {{time}}. This cannot be undone.

players.addHint: Add to the whitelist or ban by name, even players who have never joined.
players.addHintWhitelistOff: Add to the whitelist or ban by name. The whitelist is off, so anyone can join; turn it on in Game settings.
players.name: Player name
players.nameInvalid: Use only letters A–Z, digits and underscores, 3 to 16 characters.

whitelist.sent: Sent the command to whitelist {{name}}. The result shows in the Console.

ban.sent: Sent the command to ban {{name}}. The result shows in the Console.

players.stoppedHint: The server is stopped: you can still change the whitelist, ops and bans. Kicking, freezing and teleporting need a running server.
players.noneKnownHint: Players who joined, are whitelisted, are ops or are banned show up here.
players.uuidUnknown: Unknown (this player has not joined yet)
players.reasonHint: Optional. The player sees it when kicked or banned.

blocked.stopped: The server is stopped: only the whitelist, ops and bans can change. Start the server to kick, freeze, teleport or message.
blocked.offline: This player is offline: kicking, freezing, teleporting and messaging need them in the game.

done.sent: Command sent. The result shows in the Console.
done.saved: Saved. It takes effect when the server starts.

tile.starting: Waiting for the server to start
